units.rawText: Persicaria and Antonina walk the singed earth with a retinue of support personnel. That bright white light had long dispersed.
units.displayText: Persicaria and Antonina walk the singed earth with a retinue of support personnel. That bright white light had long dispersed.

spans.text: Persicaria and Antonina walk the singed earth with a retinue of support personnel. That bright white light had long dispersed.

units.rawText: Even if they already know the answer deep down, the two still scan for that orange-maned figure, almost expectantly believing that that ever-smiling face would appear again.
units.displayText: Even if they already know the answer deep down, the two still scan for that orange-maned figure, almost expectantly believing that that ever-smiling face would appear again.

spans.text: Even if they already know the answer deep down, the two still scan for that orange-maned figure, almost expectantly believing that that ever-smiling face would appear again.

units.rawText: Persicaria, over there...
units.displayText: Persicaria, over there...

spans.text: Persicaria, over there...

units.rawText: Persicaria follows the agent's gestures, finding a body burned far beyond recognition. Not far from her is a sword impaled in the earth.
units.displayText: Persicaria follows the agent's gestures, finding a body burned far beyond recognition. Not far from her is a sword impaled in the earth.

spans.text: Persicaria follows the agent's gestures, finding a body burned far beyond recognition. Not far from her is a sword impaled in the earth.

units.rawText: Even after such grueling battles and intense punishment, it never fell, not unlike its master.
units.displayText: Even after such grueling battles and intense punishment, it never fell, not unlike its master.

spans.text: Even after such grueling battles and intense punishment, it never fell, not unlike its master.

units.rawText: No, it can't be...
units.displayText: No, it can't be...

spans.text: No, it can't be...

units.rawText: Persicaria murmurs to herself, but she cannot stop herself from approaching that splintered corpse.
units.displayText: Persicaria murmurs to herself, but she cannot stop herself from approaching that splintered corpse.

spans.text: Persicaria murmurs to herself, but she cannot stop herself from approaching that splintered corpse.

units.rawText: Even after the railgun's rite of baptism, the marks left by the blade and bullet can still be seen, inscribed deep into the bone. Save for those marks, traces of Entropization are also present.
units.displayText: Even after the railgun's rite of baptism, the marks left by the blade and bullet can still be seen, inscribed deep into the bone. Save for those marks, traces of Entropization are also present.

spans.text: Even after the railgun's rite of baptism, the marks left by the blade and bullet can still be seen, inscribed deep into the bone. Save for those marks, traces of Entropization are also present.

units.rawText: [Signature verification complete. ID: Doll "Sol".]
units.displayText: [Signature verification complete. ID: Doll "Sol".]

spans.text: [Signature verification complete. ID: Doll "Sol".]

units.rawText: The cold, inhospitable electronic voice announces the reality that has come to pass.
units.displayText: The cold, inhospitable electronic voice announces the reality that has come to pass.

spans.text: The cold, inhospitable electronic voice announces the reality that has come to pass.

units.rawText: <size=36>How could it?!</size>
units.displayText: How could it?!

spans.text: How could it?!

units.rawText: Persicaria, calm...
units.displayText: Persicaria, calm...

spans.text: Persicaria, calm...

units.rawText: Antonina wraps Persicaria in her arms. She feels the body in her embrace gradually lose strength, like vitality is being siphoned from it.
units.displayText: Antonina wraps Persicaria in her arms. She feels the body in her embrace gradually lose strength, like vitality is being siphoned from it.

spans.text: Antonina wraps Persicaria in her arms. She feels the body in her embrace gradually lose strength, like vitality is being siphoned from it.

units.rawText: A cold liquid falls onto her arm, and Antonina realizes that she, too, is crying.
units.displayText: A cold liquid falls onto her arm, and Antonina realizes that she, too, is crying.

spans.text: A cold liquid falls onto her arm, and Antonina realizes that she, too, is crying.

units.rawText: The body dissolves into operands, vanishing into the air. Seemingly ignorant of that fact, Persicaria holds what remains of Sol close.
units.displayText: The body dissolves into operands, vanishing into the air. Seemingly ignorant of that fact, Persicaria holds what remains of Sol close.

spans.text: The body dissolves into operands, vanishing into the air. Seemingly ignorant of that fact, Persicaria holds what remains of Sol close.

units.rawText: ...Any possibility of a reset?
units.displayText: ...Any possibility of a reset?

spans.text: ...Any possibility of a reset?

units.rawText: The Entropization's gotten to the core. It's already...
units.displayText: The Entropization's gotten to the core. It's already...

spans.text: The Entropization's gotten to the core. It's already...

units.rawText: Antonina does not have it in her to continue. The two sit in silence, watching as the body becomes translucent, bit by bit.
units.displayText: Antonina does not have it in her to continue. The two sit in silence, watching as the body becomes translucent, bit by bit.

spans.text: Antonina does not have it in her to continue. The two sit in silence, watching as the body becomes translucent, bit by bit.

units.rawText: Persicaria stays in that selfsame position, still clasping something.
units.displayText: Persicaria stays in that selfsame position, still clasping something.

spans.text: Persicaria stays in that selfsame position, still clasping something.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: But we... we made it.
units.displayText: But we... we made it.

spans.text: But we... we made it.

units.rawText: Persicaria grips her hands tightly. What she should rightly still have in her arms is now gone, an emptiness where it ought to be. Operands slowly trickle down her hand, seeping from a cut on her finger.
units.displayText: Persicaria grips her hands tightly. What she should rightly still have in her arms is now gone, an emptiness where it ought to be. Operands slowly trickle down her hand, seeping from a cut on her finger.

spans.text: Persicaria grips her hands tightly. What she should rightly still have in her arms is now gone, an emptiness where it ought to be. Operands slowly trickle down her hand, seeping from a cut on her finger.

units.rawText: As the body completely dissipates, something appears to shine. It was a tiny little bottle.
units.displayText: As the body completely dissipates, something appears to shine. It was a tiny little bottle.

spans.text: As the body completely dissipates, something appears to shine. It was a tiny little bottle.

units.rawText: I imagine the Oasis must be a place full of greenery where everyone can live without fear or worry.
units.displayText: I imagine the Oasis must be a place full of greenery where everyone can live without fear or worry.

spans.text: I imagine the Oasis must be a place full of greenery where everyone can live without fear or worry.

units.rawText: You think? Then I'll grow a little strand of grass in there, and we'll see whether or not the Oasis is what we imagined!
units.displayText: You think? Then I'll grow a little strand of grass in there, and we'll see whether or not the Oasis is what we imagined!

spans.text: You think? Then I'll grow a little strand of grass in there, and we'll see whether or not the Oasis is what we imagined!

units.rawText: This speck of green, I now leave to you.
units.displayText: This speck of green, I now leave to you.

spans.text: This speck of green, I now leave to you.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: After heaven knows how many repeated attempts, a familiar voice finally comes through the other end of the call.
units.displayText: After heaven knows how many repeated attempts, a familiar voice finally comes through the other end of the call.

spans.text: After heaven knows how many repeated attempts, a familiar voice finally comes through the other end of the call.

units.rawText: Antonina!
units.displayText: Antonina!

spans.text: Antonina!

units.rawText: ...It's me.
units.displayText: ...It's me.

spans.text: ...It's me.

units.rawText: I notice it in Antonina's voice—a stifled gasp, a suppressed sob. My instincts declare to me that disaster has struck.
units.displayText: I notice it in Antonina's voice—a stifled gasp, a suppressed sob. My instincts declare to me that disaster has struck.

spans.text: I notice it in Antonina's voice—a stifled gasp, a suppressed sob. My instincts declare to me that disaster has struck.

units.rawText: What happened?
units.displayText: What happened?

spans.text: What happened?

units.rawText: Sol, she... to stop Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Sol, she... to stop Eosphorus...

spans.text: Sol, she... to stop Eosphorus...

units.rawText: Antonina does not finish, but what she means could not be more clear.
units.displayText: Antonina does not finish, but what she means could not be more clear.

spans.text: Antonina does not finish, but what she means could not be more clear.

units.rawText: I grasp my terminal tightly, scrambling to find where my voice has gone.
units.displayText: I grasp my terminal tightly, scrambling to find where my voice has gone.

spans.text: I grasp my terminal tightly, scrambling to find where my voice has gone.

units.rawText: What of everyone else?
units.displayText: What of everyone else?

spans.text: What of everyone else?

units.rawText: The Oasis is safe. We're restoring order, and treating the wounded.
units.displayText: The Oasis is safe. We're restoring order, and treating the wounded.

spans.text: The Oasis is safe. We're restoring order, and treating the wounded.

units.rawText: Additionally, we found a fragment of Eosphorus on-site. Analysis has determined that it was nothing more than a fragment of Eosphorus that came to the Oasis.
units.displayText: Additionally, we found a fragment of Eosphorus on-site. Analysis has determined that it was nothing more than a fragment of Eosphorus that came to the Oasis.

spans.text: Additionally, we found a fragment of Eosphorus on-site. Analysis has determined that it was nothing more than a fragment of Eosphorus that came to the Oasis.

units.rawText: Sol... kept it for us.
units.displayText: Sol... kept it for us.

spans.text: Sol... kept it for us.

units.rawText: ...I see. I'm on my way back.
units.displayText: ...I see. I'm on my way back.

spans.text: ...I see. I'm on my way back.

units.rawText: I end the call, and Eucharist gives me a shrug.
units.displayText: I end the call, and Eucharist gives me a shrug.

spans.text: I end the call, and Eucharist gives me a shrug.

units.rawText: Didn't lie, did I? The intel was all real and valid.
units.displayText: Didn't lie, did I? The intel was all real and valid.

spans.text: Didn't lie, did I? The intel was all real and valid.

units.rawText: You have Eosphorus behind you?
units.displayText: You have Eosphorus behind you?

spans.text: You have Eosphorus behind you?

units.rawText: Way to state the obvious. Well, a promise is a promise, I'm out~
units.displayText: Way to state the obvious. Well, a promise is a promise, I'm out~

spans.text: Way to state the obvious. Well, a promise is a promise, I'm out~

units.rawText: You'll not escape so easily! All Sanctifiers, prepare to fire!
units.displayText: You'll not escape so easily! All Sanctifiers, prepare to fire!

spans.text: You'll not escape so easily! All Sanctifiers, prepare to fire!

units.rawText: Come on, this wasn't what we agreed to!
units.displayText: Come on, this wasn't what we agreed to!

spans.text: Come on, this wasn't what we agreed to!

units.rawText: Your intel came too late. Me letting you go doesn't mean that the Sanctifiers will, either.
units.displayText: Your intel came too late. Me letting you go doesn't mean that the Sanctifiers will, either.

spans.text: Your intel came too late. Me letting you go doesn't mean that the Sanctifiers will, either.

units.rawText: Should we fire?
units.displayText: Should we fire?

spans.text: Should we fire?

units.rawText: You decide yourself.
units.displayText: You decide yourself.

spans.text: You decide yourself.

units.rawText: <color=red>Entering purge mode!</color>
units.displayText: Entering purge mode!

spans.text: Entering purge mode!

units.rawText: <size=32>Oi</size> <size=36>oi</size> <size=40>oi</size> <size=44>oi</size> <size=48>oi!?</size>
units.displayText: Oi oi oi oi oi!?

spans.text: Oi
oi
oi
oi
oi!?

units.rawText: What the hell is this?! A slingshot? What are you——
units.displayText: What the hell is this?! A slingshot? What are you——

spans.text: What the hell is this?! A slingshot? What are you——

units.rawText: With a cloud of smoke and dust, Eucharist was nowhere to be seen.
units.displayText: With a cloud of smoke and dust, Eucharist was nowhere to be seen.

spans.text: With a cloud of smoke and dust, Eucharist was nowhere to be seen.

units.rawText: I collapse onto the chair, a sense of paralysis overcoming me.
units.displayText: I collapse onto the chair, a sense of paralysis overcoming me.

spans.text: I collapse onto the chair, a sense of paralysis overcoming me.

units.rawText:
Eucharist's betrayed the Sanctifiers as well as Eosphorus. There'll be nowhere she can go for shelter.
But the important matter at hand is the Reverse Babylon Tower...
units.displayText:
Eucharist's betrayed the Sanctifiers as well as Eosphorus. There'll be nowhere she can go for shelter.
But the important matter at hand is the Reverse Babylon Tower...

spans.text:
Eucharist's betrayed the Sanctifiers as well as Eosphorus. There'll be nowhere she can go for shelter.
But the important matter at hand is the Reverse Babylon Tower...

units.rawText: Scattered thoughts dominate my mind. Before I had the time to delve deep, Faith received an emergency message addressed to her from a Lesser Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Scattered thoughts dominate my mind. Before I had the time to delve deep, Faith received an emergency message addressed to her from a Lesser Sanctifier.

spans.text: Scattered thoughts dominate my mind. Before I had the time to delve deep, Faith received an emergency message addressed to her from a Lesser Sanctifier.

units.rawText: As she processes the contents of the message, Faith's expression alters several times, and she nods at the end of it all.
units.displayText: As she processes the contents of the message, Faith's expression alters several times, and she nods at the end of it all.

spans.text: As she processes the contents of the message, Faith's expression alters several times, and she nods at the end of it all.

units.rawText: ...I understand, Lord Hesperus. I shall return to the Reverse Babylon Tower at once.
units.displayText: ...I understand, Lord Hesperus. I shall return to the Reverse Babylon Tower at once.

spans.text: ...I understand, Lord Hesperus. I shall return to the Reverse Babylon Tower at once.

units.rawText: Apologies, Professor <cmdr>. Thank you for your cooperation, but it would appear our collaboration here is at an end.
units.displayText: Apologies, Professor {교수}. Thank you for your cooperation, but it would appear our collaboration here is at an end.

spans.text: Apologies, Professor
. Thank you for your cooperation, but it would appear our collaboration here is at an end.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower is having an internal struggle, is it not?
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower is having an internal struggle, is it not?

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower is having an internal struggle, is it not?

units.rawText: You need not worry if I am siding with Eosphorus. He has attacked the Oasis, and we share a common front.
units.displayText: You need not worry if I am siding with Eosphorus. He has attacked the Oasis, and we share a common front.

spans.text: You need not worry if I am siding with Eosphorus. He has attacked the Oasis, and we share a common front.

units.rawText: We are in possession of intel about Eosphorus. If Lord Hesperus is willing, we would be more than happy to exchange information.
units.displayText: We are in possession of intel about Eosphorus. If Lord Hesperus is willing, we would be more than happy to exchange information.

spans.text: We are in possession of intel about Eosphorus. If Lord Hesperus is willing, we would be more than happy to exchange information.

units.rawText: Faith hesitates, but ultimately nods with our previously established trust in mind.
units.displayText: Faith hesitates, but ultimately nods with our previously established trust in mind.

spans.text: Faith hesitates, but ultimately nods with our previously established trust in mind.

units.rawText: Eosphorus has headed an en-masse defection. In the future, Sanctifiers may pose dangers to you. Please be careful.
units.displayText: Eosphorus has headed an en-masse defection. In the future, Sanctifiers may pose dangers to you. Please be careful.

spans.text: Eosphorus has headed an en-masse defection. In the future, Sanctifiers may pose dangers to you. Please be careful.

units.rawText: After giving me a succinct response, Faith leads the Lessers away on her route back.
units.displayText: After giving me a succinct response, Faith leads the Lessers away on her route back.

spans.text: After giving me a succinct response, Faith leads the Lessers away on her route back.

units.rawText: I look towards the Reverse Babylon Tower, standing tall in the distance. I do not know if it is a mere hallucination, but an aura of purple seems to hover thereabouts.
units.displayText: I look towards the Reverse Babylon Tower, standing tall in the distance. I do not know if it is a mere hallucination, but an aura of purple seems to hover thereabouts.

spans.text: I look towards the Reverse Babylon Tower, standing tall in the distance. I do not know if it is a mere hallucination, but an aura of purple seems to hover thereabouts.

units.rawText: After a moment of thought, I make another call.
units.displayText: After a moment of thought, I make another call.

spans.text: After a moment of thought, I make another call.

units.rawText: Professor, Sol, she...
units.displayText: Professor, Sol, she...

spans.text: Professor, Sol, she...

units.rawText: I know. Prepare our people, we're going back to the Oasis.
units.displayText: I know. Prepare our people, we're going back to the Oasis.

spans.text: I know. Prepare our people, we're going back to the Oasis.

units.rawText: And then?
units.displayText: And then?

spans.text: And then?

units.rawText: We're off to Enigma. The quantum database there can help us analyze the fragment Eosphorus left behind and pinpoint his weaknesses.
units.displayText: We're off to Enigma. The quantum database there can help us analyze the fragment Eosphorus left behind and pinpoint his weaknesses.

spans.text: We're off to Enigma. The quantum database there can help us analyze the fragment Eosphorus left behind and pinpoint his weaknesses.

units.rawText: I gaze off into the distance in the direction of the Oasis. The flames have ceased, but I know that some are no longer with us.
units.displayText: I gaze off into the distance in the direction of the Oasis. The flames have ceased, but I know that some are no longer with us.

spans.text: I gaze off into the distance in the direction of the Oasis. The flames have ceased, but I know that some are no longer with us.

units.rawText: <color=red>Eosphorus will pay for what he has done.</color>
units.displayText: Eosphorus will pay for what he has done.

spans.text: Eosphorus will pay for what he has done.

units.rawText: >> PERILOUS ADVANCEMENT // E N D . . .
units.displayText: >> PERILOUS ADVANCEMENT // E N D . . .

spans.text: >> PERILOUS ADVANCEMENT // E N D . . .

units.rawText: (I should have realized long ago.)
units.displayText: I should have realized long ago.

spans.text: I should have realized long ago.

units.rawText: (For Eucharist to easily escape and travel to Pierides and Burbank, and for Eosphorus to be involved in every crisis related to the Entropics...)
units.displayText: For Eucharist to easily escape and travel to Pierides and Burbank, and for Eosphorus to be involved in every crisis related to the Entropics...

spans.text: For Eucharist to easily escape and travel to Pierides and Burbank, and for Eosphorus to be involved in every crisis related to the Entropics...

units.rawText: (To think of it, he allows us to use the Sandbox Barrier as we desire because we remove Sanctifier influence in those sectors for him, therefore making more points of injection available for the Entropics.)
units.displayText: To think of it, he allows us to use the Sandbox Barrier as we desire because we remove Sanctifier influence in those sectors for him, therefore making more points of injection available for the Entropics.

spans.text: To think of it, he allows us to use the Sandbox Barrier as we desire because we remove Sanctifier influence in those sectors for him, therefore making more points of injection available for the Entropics.

units.rawText: (I ought to have taken precautions, but I was deceived by his words and identity as a Sanctifier...)
units.displayText: I ought to have taken precautions, but I was deceived by his words and identity as a Sanctifier...

spans.text: I ought to have taken precautions, but I was deceived by his words and identity as a Sanctifier...

units.rawText: (What exactly are Eosphorus' goals? Why is Antonina his primary target?)
units.displayText: What exactly are Eosphorus' goals? Why is Antonina his primary target?

spans.text: What exactly are Eosphorus' goals? Why is Antonina his primary target?
